title: SKILL — Scroll‑Triggered Sticky CTA with Auto‑Hide on Down‑Scroll
effect: Keeps the primary CTA (“Сделаю демо …”) constantly in sight, increasing click‑through rates while staying unobtrusive during content consumption.
risk: Requires a single `.sticky-cta` element in the markup; if omitted the script does nothing. JS is lightweight (< 1 KB) and safe‑by‑design (no external calls).
rollback:
Delete the added `
…
` block, the CSS rules, and the JS snippet; or `git checkout -- index.html`.
verify:
1) Insert `
Сделаю демо бесплатно →
` before ``. 2) Load page, scroll down – CTA should slide out of view. 3) Scroll up – CTA slides back in. 4) Test on mobile viewport (375 px) to ensure no overlap with native UI.
priority_claim: 2 – higher impact on conversions but slightly more effort; suitable after the quick accessibility win.
